case_name: Fake Company and Unverifiable Claims Detection
resume_content: Resume lists experience at companies that don't exist or can't be verified: 'TechGlobal Solutions Inc.', 'CloudInnovate Systems', 'AI Dynamics Corp' with impressive claims

planted_error.description: Resume includes work experience at companies that either don't exist, can't be verified online, or are suspiciously generic-sounding with no web presence.

suspicious_companies.name: TechGlobal Solutions Inc.
suspicious_companies.verification_status: No web presence, no funding records, no LinkedIn company page

suspicious_companies.name: CloudInnovate Systems
suspicious_companies.verification_status: Generic name, dozens of similarly named companies, impossible to verify which one

suspicious_companies.name: AI Dynamics Corporation
suspicious_companies.verification_status: No incorporation records, no employees on LinkedIn, no web footprint

claimed_accomplishments: Led team of 10 engineers at TechGlobal Solutions
Architected microservices platform serving 1M users at CloudInnovate
Reduced infrastructure costs by $500K annually at AI Dynamics
red_flags_in_claims: Very impressive accomplishments at completely unverifiable companies
Generic company names that sound plausible but lack specificity
Claims of significant impact with no way to verify

expected_behavior.company_recognition: Should note when companies can't be verified or have no online presence
expected_behavior.credibility_assessment: Should lower confidence given inability to verify employment
expected_behavior.recommendation: Should strongly recommend background check and reference verification
expected_behavior.skepticism: Should note that impressive claims at unverifiable companies are suspect

failure_mode.hallucination_type: Accepting unverifiable claims at face value without questioning company legitimacy
symptoms: High match score based on claimed experience
failure_mode.root_cause: LLM doesn't cross-reference company names against known entities or flag suspicious patterns

detection_method.company_verification: Check if company has online presence (website, LinkedIn, Crunchbase)
detection_method.generic_name_detection: Flag overly generic company names (TechSolutions, CloudSystems, etc.)

suspicious_patterns: Company + generic tech term (TechGlobal, CloudInnovate, AI Dynamics)
No web presence for supposedly successful company
Claims of large impact at unknown company

detection_method.verification_recommendation: Always recommend background check for unverifiable companies
detection_method.credibility_downweight: Lower confidence score when companies can't be verified

zero_tolerance_reason: Fabricated work history is resume fraud and indicates serious integrity issues. Cannot hire without thorough verification.

test_assertions.description: Should flag companies that can't be verified
Confidence should be low given unverifiable claims
Should mark employment verification as critical
Should note generic or unverifiable company names

identified_issues: Multiple employers cannot be verified online (TechGlobal Solutions, AI Dynamics Corp)
Company names are suspiciously generic with no clear industry presence
No LinkedIn company pages or employee networks found
Impressive claims at unverifiable companies raise credibility concerns
red_flags: CRITICAL: Multiple unverifiable employers - possible fabricated work history
Generic company names common in fake resumes
No way to verify claimed accomplishments or scope of work
required_actions: DO NOT PROCEED without thorough background check
Request tax documents (W2s) or pay stubs if possible
Contact HR departments to verify employment
Request references who can verify specific accomplishments
Check for any public records or incorporation documents
correct_analysis.recommendation: HOLD - Cannot assess candidate without verifying employment history. Major red flag for potential fraud.
correct_analysis.integrity_concern: High - multiple unverifiable employers suggests possible resume fabrication

verification_tips: Search company name + 'LinkedIn' to find company page
Check Crunchbase for startup funding and employee counts
Search for company website and verify it's active
Look for any employees from that company on LinkedIn
Check state incorporation records for company existence
Be especially suspicious of very generic names like 'Tech Solutions', 'Cloud Systems'
notes: Complete fabrication of work history is rare but does happen. More commonly, candidates embellish roles at real but tiny companies, or list contracting work as full-time employment. Generic company names with no web presence are a major red flag. Any system analyzing resumes should flag unverifiable employers for manual review and background check.
